page.title: QR: a QR code that’s yours to keep · Honest Robin
page.description: Make a QR code for a link or any text, checked before you print it. Free as free gets: no sign-up. The code opens your link directly, not through us, so it works for as long as your link does. We never see what you type.
page.headline: A QR code that’s yours to keep.
page.lede: Free as free gets: no sign-up. The code opens your link directly, not through us, so it works for as long as your link does. We never see what you type.
page.fieldLabel: Link or text for the code
page.placeholder: Paste a link, or type anything
page.robinHello: I’m the robin. I’m here to lighten up your day.
page.which: PNG works in every app. SVG stays sharp at any size, so it’s the better one for print.
page.imageNote: Your image is never uploaded. We’ll check that it still scans.
page.family: Part of the Honest Robin family.

script.asText: Phones will show this as text.
script.addHttps: Phones may show this as text instead of opening it.

script.tooLongWide: Too long for one code. A code holds about {most} plain characters, and fewer when letters like č or emoji take more room.
script.tooLongForImage: Too long for a code with an image. Remove the image, or use a shorter link.

script.inverted: Newer phones read this. Some older scanner apps can’t.
